1.text: Tha word of tha LORD dat came 2 Joel tha son of Pethuel.
Hear dis, y’all old men, N listen up, all y’all inhabitants of tha land. has dis been in ur days, or even in tha days of ur fathers?
Tell y’all ur children of it, N let ur children tell their children, N their children another generation.
Dat which tha palmerworm has left has tha locust eaten; N dat which tha locust has left has tha cankerworm eaten; N dat which tha cankerworm has left has tha caterpiller eaten.
Awake, y’all drunkards, N weep; N howl, all y’all drinkers of wine, because of tha new wine; 4 it is cut off from ur mouth.
4 a nation is come up upon my land, strong, N without number, whose teeth r tha teeth of a lion, N he has tha cheek teeth of a great lion.
He has laid my vine waste, N barked my fig tree: he has made it clean bare, N cast it away; tha branches of it r made white.
Lament like a virgin girded wit sackcloth 4 tha husband of her youth.
Tha food offering N tha drink offering is cut off from tha house of tha LORD; tha priests, tha LORD’s ministers, mourn.
Tha field is wasted, tha land mourns; 4 tha corn is wasted: tha new wine is dried up, tha oil languishes.
Be y’all ashamed, O y’all husbandmen; howl, O y’all vinedressers, 4 tha wheat N 4 tha barley; because tha harvest of tha field is perished.

Tha vine is dried up, N tha fig tree languishes; tha pomegranate tree, tha palm tree also, N tha apple tree, even all tha trees of tha field, r withered: because joy is withered away from tha sons of men.

Gird y’all, N lament, y’all priests: howl, y’all ministers of tha altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, y’all ministers of my God: 4 tha food offering N tha drink offering is withholden from tha house of ur God.
Sanctify y’all a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather tha elders N all tha inhabitants of tha land in2 tha house of tha LORD ur God, N cry 2 tha LORD,
Alas 4 tha day! 4 tha day of tha LORD is at hand, N as a destruction from tha Almighty shall it come.
Is not tha food cut off before our eyes, yeah, joy N gladness from tha house of our God?
Tha seed is rotten under their clods, tha garners r laid desolate, tha barns r broken down; 4 tha corn is withered.
How do tha beasts groan! tha herds of cattle r perplexed, because dey have no pasture; yeah, tha flocks of sheep r made desolate.
O LORD, 2 u will I cry: 4 tha fire has devoured tha pastures of tha wilderness, N tha flame has burned all tha trees of tha field.
Tha beasts of tha field cry also 2 u: 4 tha rivers of waterz r dried up, N tha fire has devoured tha pastures of tha wilderness.

2.text: Blow y’all tha trumpet in Zion, N sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all tha inhabitants of tha land tremble: 4 tha day of tha LORD comes, 4 it is nigh at hand;

A day of darkness N of gloominess, a day of clouds N of thick darkness, as tha morning spread upon tha mountains: a great people N a strong; there has not been ever tha like, neither shall be any more after it, even 2 tha years of many generations.
A fire devours before ’em; N behind ’em a flame burns: tha land is as tha garden of Eden before ’em, N behind ’em a desolate wilderness; yeah, N nothing shall escape ’em.
Tha appearance of ’em is as tha appearance of horses; N as horsemen, so shall dey run.
Like tha noise of chariots on tha tops of mountains shall dey leap, like tha noise of a flame of fire dat devours tha stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
Before their face tha people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
Dey shall run like mighty men; dey shall climb tha wall like men of war; N dey shall march every one on his ways, N dey shall not break their ranks:
Neither shall one thrust another; dey shall walk every one in his path: N when dey fall upon tha sword, dey shall not be wounded.
Dey shall run 2 N fro in tha city; dey shall run upon tha wall, dey shall climb up upon tha houses; dey shall enter in at tha windows like a thief.
Tha earth shall quake before ’em; tha heavenz shall tremble: tha sun N tha moon shall be dark, N tha stars shall withdraw their shinin:
N tha LORD shall utter his voice before his army: 4 his camp is very great: 4 he is strong dat executes his word: 4 tha day of tha LORD is great N very terrible; N who can abide it?
Therefore also now, says tha LORD, turn y’all even 2 me wit all ur heart, N wit fasting, N wit weepin, N wit mournin:
N rend ur heart, N not ur garments, N turn 2 tha LORD ur God: 4 he is gracious N merciful, slow 2 anger, N of great kindness, N repenteth him of tha evil.
Who knows if he will return N repent, N leave a blessing behind him; even a food offering N a drink offering 2 tha LORD ur God?
Blow tha trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
Gather tha people, sanctify tha congregation, assemble tha elders, gather tha children, N dose dat suck tha breasts: let tha bridegroom go forth of his chamber, N tha bride out of her closet.

Let tha priests, tha ministers of tha LORD, weep between tha porch N tha altar, N let ’em say, Spare ur people, O LORD, N give not thine heritage 2 reproach, dat tha heathen should rule over ’em: so should dey say among tha people, Where is their God?
Then will tha LORD be jealous 4 his land, N pity his people.
Yeah, tha LORD will answer N say 2 his people, look, I will send u corn, N wine, N oil, N y’all shall be satisfied wit it: N I will no more make u a reproach among tha heathen:

But I will remove far off from u tha northern army, N will drive him in2 a land barren N desolate, wit his face toward tha east sea, N his hinder part toward tha utmost sea, N his stink shall come up, N his ill savour shall come up, because he has done great things.
Don’t fear, O land; be glad N rejoice: 4 tha LORD will do great things.
Don’t be afraid, y’all beasts of tha field: 4 tha pastures of tha wilderness do spring, 4 tha tree bears her fruit, tha fig tree N tha vine do yield their strength.

Be glad then, y’all children of Zion, N rejoice in tha LORD ur God: 4 he has given u tha former rain moderately, N he will cause 2 come down 4 u tha rain, tha former rain, N tha latter rain in tha first month.
N tha floors shall be full of wheat, N tha fats shall overflow wit wine N oil.
N I will restore 2 u tha years dat tha locust has eaten, tha cankerworm, N tha caterpiller, N tha palmerworm, my great army which I sent among u.
N y’all shall eat in plenty, N be satisfied, N praise tha name of tha LORD ur God, dat has dealt wondrously wit u: N my people shall never be ashamed.
N y’all shall know dat I am in tha midst of Israel, N dat I am tha LORD ur God, N none else: N my people shall never be ashamed.
N it will happen afterward, dat I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; N ur sons N ur daughters shall prophesy, ur old men shall dream dreams, ur young men shall see visions:
N also upon tha servants N upon tha handmaids in dose days will I pour out my spirit.
N I will show wonders in tha heavenz N in tha earth, blood, N fire, N pillars of smoke.
Tha sun shall be turned in2 darkness, N tha moon in2 blood, before tha great N tha terrible day of tha LORD come.

N it will happen, dat whoever shall call on tha name of tha LORD shall be delivered: 4 in mount Zion N in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as tha LORD has said, N in tha remnant whom tha LORD shall call.

3.text: 4, look, in dose days, N in dat time, when I shall bring again tha captivity of Judah N Jerusalem,

I will also gather all nations, N will bring ’em down in2 tha valley of Jehoshaphat, N will plead wit ’em there 4 my people N 4 my heritage Israel, whom dey have scattered among tha nations, N parted my land.
N dey have cast lots 4 my people; N have given a boy 4 an harlot, N sold a girl 4 wine, dat dey might drink.

Yeah, N what have y’all 2 do wit me, O Tyre, N Zidon, N all tha coasts of Palestine? will y’all render me a recompence? N if y’all recompense me, swiftly N speedily will I return ur recompence upon ur own head;
Because y’all have taken my silver N my gold, N have carried in2 ur temples my goodly pleasant things:
Tha children also of Judah N tha children of Jerusalem have y’all sold 2 tha Grecians, dat y’all might remove ’em far from their border.
Look, I will raise ’em out of tha place where y’all have sold ’em, N will return ur recompence upon ur own head:
N I will sell ur sons N ur daughters in2 tha hand of tha children of Judah, N dey shall sell ’em 2 tha Sabeans, 2 a people far off: 4 tha LORD has spoken it.
Proclaim y’all dis among tha Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up tha mighty men, let all tha men of war draw near; let ’em come up:
Beat ur plowshares in2 swords, N ur pruninghooks in2 spears: let tha weak say, I am strong.
Assemble y’all, N come, all y’all heathen, N gather y’all together round about: there cause ur mighty ones 2 come down, O LORD. shall bring down
Let tha heathen be wakened, N come up 2 tha valley of Jehoshaphat: 4 there will I sit 2 judge all tha heathen round about.
Put y’all in tha sickle, 4 tha harvest is ripe: come, get u down; 4 tha press is full, tha fats overflow; 4 their wickedness is great.
Crowds, crowds in tha valley of decision: 4 tha day of tha LORD is near in tha valley of decision.
Tha sun N tha moon shall be darkened, N tha stars shall withdraw their shinin.
Tha LORD also shall roar out of Zion, N utter his voice from Jerusalem; N tha heavenz N tha earth shall shake: but tha LORD will be tha hope of his people, N tha strength of tha children of Israel.
So shall y’all know dat I am tha LORD ur God livin in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, N there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

N it will happen in dat day, dat tha mountains shall drop down new wine, N tha hills shall flow wit milk, N all tha rivers of Judah shall flow wit waterz, N a fountain shall come forth of tha house of tha LORD, N shall water tha valley of Shittim.
Egypt shall be a desolation, N Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, 4 tha violence against tha children of Judah, because dey have shed innocent blood in their land.
But Judah shall live 4 ever, N Jerusalem from generation 2 generation.
4 I will cleanse their blood dat I have not cleansed: 4 tha LORD lives in Zion. dat
